browser.command: node development/tests/integration/probe_watch_cards.cjs --browser <explicit Edge executable> --output <owned scratch evidence directory>

limitations: Hidden browser uses synthetic loopback data and a fresh owned profile, not a real-source browser or personal browser state.
Text-size scaling and viewport coverage do not prove every native page-zoom, physical-touch, screen-reader or macOS combination.
Natural real-source live cost correction timing was not independently demonstrated; controlled accepted SSE updates, stale rejection and reconnect remain deterministic coverage.
Daily history cancellation produced one instrumented error per history method at shutdown; this was not a Daily verification campaign.
Tracked thread/multiprocessing cleanup is not an inventory of all OS helpers.
Canonical CLI/valuation still normalize missing token counters; only full Watch applies component evidence flags, per the scoped Decision Delegate decision.
